alice: Heads-up: prepping SI Cohort D kickoff. Need a "readiness runway" checklist that partners complete 7 days before clinic. Want it short and automatable. Thoughts?
jerome: Short list: marketplace profile done, NDA signed, hardware loan request submitted (if needed), sample deploy run pass, telemetry tag present. Keep it to 6 checks so partners can finish fast.
nina: Add a required confirmation of preferred announcement cadence (none|blog|webinar). Also require contact for SE walkthrough scheduling. We should auto-schedule when they select preferred times.
carlos: For the sample deploy, make it a simple smoke script that returns 3 metrics: latency_ms, tokens_per_second, model_variant. If they post artifacts to the intake URL we auto-verify and award a "ready-for-clinic" flag.
alice: I like auto-verify. Can we let Bronze partners skip the hardware loan step? Only Dedicated applicants must request loaners. Also want a checkbox: "consent_to_basic_audit" for random spot checks.
jerome: Yes. Proposed YAML-lite flow (for intake engine):
```
runway_checks:
  - marketplace_profile_completed
  - nda_signed
  - consent_to_basic_audit
  - sample_deploy_artifact_url
  - telemetry_tag_present
  - hw_loan_requested_if_dedicated
```
nina: Also include a short SLA for scheduling: partners must pick two 60-min windows within 72 hours of readiness. Otherwise we move them to the next cohort. Add this to intake confirmation text.
carlos: We'll add a signed webhook call that posts verification results back to the partner portal. Example payload: {partner_id, runway_status, evidence_urls}. Use an HMAC header.
alice: Action items: 1) Jerome to quick-add fields to intake form (ETA Tue); 2) Carlos to write smoke script + verification endpoint (ETA Wed); 3) Nina to draft intake copy + scheduling SLA (ETA Tue). Onboarding-bot: create ticket.
onboarding-bot: Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-SI-6060 "SI Cohort D readiness runway + auto-verify"
alice: Thanks all. We'll run a small pilot with 6 partners. I'll post the final checklist in Confluence and share with partnerships by EOD Friday. :rocket:
